sources.title: qwen3-vl-plus model card
sources.evidence: Complete indexed card gives text/image/video input, text output, 262144-token context and regional function-calling support. Direct fetch exceeded the browser's size limit; indexed content was accessible. Counts and architecture are absent.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Release table explicitly lists qwen3-vl-plus and qwen3-vl-plus-2025-09-23 on 2025-09-23; describes thinking/non-thinking modes, visual agents, spatial perception and long-video understanding. Later regional/update rows do not replace initial availability. Reopened on 2026-10-27: the Plus release/update entries describe capabilities and snapshots, without total/active counts or a size-specific base model.

sources.title: Model inference pricing
sources.evidence: Indexed pricing documentation says the qwen3-vl-plus alias is currently equivalent to qwen3-vl-plus-2025-12-19 and supports thinking and non-thinking modes.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL official repository
sources.evidence: Reopened on 2026-10-27. Official Qwen repository lists dense and MoE size-named checkpoints; its API example uses qwen3-vl-235b-a22b-instruct. Plus is not named in the README, so the repository supplies no Plus-to-checkpoint lineage. Its Apache-2.0 repository license does not establish a Plus weights license.

sources.title: Qwen API platform
sources.evidence: Indexed platform page names Qwen3-VL-Plus and text/image/video-to-text modalities, but lists 131027 context length. This conflicts with the exact Alibaba Cloud model card's 262144; no reconciliation is supplied. Direct page extraction returned no text.

sources.title: qwen3-vl-plus Model Info, current public documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened on 2026-10-27; page updated 2026-10-11. Exact Plus model card lists modalities, regional capabilities, context limits and prices but no total count, activated count, dense/MoE architecture or named size-specific base. The original console mirror timed out; this public documentation version was readable.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report, Model Architecture and comparison tables
sources.evidence: Read on 2026-10-27. Section 2 explicitly gives the flagship Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B 235B total parameters and 22B activated per token in its language-model subsection. The report covers 2B/4B/8B/32B dense and 30B-A3B/235B-A22B MoE variants, with a vision encoder and mergers. It never names Plus, so these nominal counts cannot identify Plus or establish its structural lineage.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B official model card and later multimodal comparison table
sources.evidence: Read on 2026-10-27 while checking later primary parameter/comparison disclosures. The multimodal table names Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B, not Qwen3-VL-Plus, and gives no Plus activated-parameter count. An explicit hosted-version mapping on this card applies to Qwen3.5-Plus and cannot be transferred to Qwen3-VL-Plus.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio model pricing, fresh public documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened on 2026-10-27. Current public English pricing lists qwen3-vl-plus, both thinking modes and regional token prices without parameter counts, a size-specific base or an exact snapshot mapping. The Chinese public pricing page likewise omits a mapping in the fetched version, although indexed older pricing still associates Plus with the 2025-12-19 snapshot. No newer lineage or count was found by English/Chinese exact-name searches for parameters, activation, 235B and base-model relationships.

sources.title: Official Qwen inventory search for the exact hosted model
sources.evidence: The live official organization search returned no checkpoint under the exact hosted model name. Related family releases were checked separately.

sources.title: Official Qwen Qwen3-VL weight inventory
sources.evidence: The live query returned 40 repositories. The exact Plus API card and the developer Qwen3-VL weight inventory do not provide a Plus checkpoint or identify an equivalent released model. Size-named Qwen3-VL weights are separate releases.

open_weights.note: The exact Plus API card and the developer Qwen3-VL weight inventory do not provide a Plus checkpoint or identify an equivalent released model. license.note: No exact-alias weights license disclosed; do not transfer the open repository's Apache-2.0 license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh primary-source review found no nominal total for Plus and no explicit size-specific base relationship. Published 235B belongs to Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B; family membership alone does not transfer that count. The missing evidence is model identity, not an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: No Plus activated count found in current documentation, the Qwen3-VL report or later Qwen comparison tables. The report explicitly publishes 22B per token for Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B, but supplies no mapping to Plus. No active count is inferred from a presumed total or architecture.

architecture.note: Exact hosted architecture unspecified; open-family dense/MoE variants do not resolve it.

context_window.note: Exact Alibaba Cloud card takes precedence over conflicting Qwen platform listing (131027). Indexed specification, not an API capacity test.

reasoning.note: Supports selectable thinking and non-thinking modes.

tool_call.note: Beijing card supports function calling; Singapore, Frankfurt, Virginia and Hong Kong cards mark it unsupported. Boolean means available in at least one deployment.

description.value: Alibaba Cloud Qwen3 vision-language API model for visual reasoning, spatial understanding, video understanding and visual agent tasks, with optional thinking.
description.note: Uses exact-alias documented capabilities without benchmark superlatives.

patch.description: Alibaba Cloud Qwen3 vision-language API model for visual reasoning, spatial understanding, video understanding and visual agent tasks, with optional thinking.
patch.notes: Total/active parameter counts and architecture are undisclosed; no size-specific base is identified for Plus. Published Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B counts cannot be assigned to this alias. Function calling is documented for Beijing but unsupported in the other listed regional deployments. Context follows the Alibaba Cloud card; Qwen's platform lists a conflicting 131027. No public Plus weight release is available. Classified as closed weights: no public release of this hosted variant was found in the developer documentation and weight inventory.
